(ORDER LIST: 607 U.S.)
TUESDAY, OCTOBER 14, 2025
CERTIORARI DENIED
25-5869 SHOCKLEY, LANCE V. ADAMS, WARDEN, ET AL.
(25A418)
The application for stay of execution of sentence of death
presented to Justice Kavanaugh and by him referred to the Court
is denied. The petition for a writ of certiorari is denied.
Respondents’ motion for leave to file a supplemental appendix
under seal is granted.
